page_about.title: About Rimelight
page_about.description: Learn about Rimelight Entertainment and our starter template.

page_about.section_values_description: The ideas that drive how we build our templates and application frameworks.
page_about.value_dx_description: We believe tooling should be fast, seamless, and intuitive, getting out of your way so you can create.

Rather than maintaining dozens of fragments, we build one powerful base—allowing you to easily disable what you don't need.
